relations.subject: Bahadur Chand Chhabra
relations.evidence: Chhabra graduated from the Punjab University, Lahore.

relations.subject: Bahadur Chand Chhabra
relations.evidence: He earned his doctorate from the State University of Leiden in 1934.

relations.subject: Bahadur Chand Chhabra
relations.evidence: In the early 1930s, he joined the Archaeological Survey of India as an epigraphist under J. Ph. Vogel.

relations.subject: Bahadur Chand Chhabra
relations.evidence: Chhabra succeeded Vogel as the Chief Epigraphist in 1935 and served until 1953.

relations.subject: Bahadur Chand Chhabra
relations.role: Assistant Director General and Joint Director General
relations.evidence: In 1953, he became the Assistant Director General and then, the Joint Director General of the Archaeological Survey of India. Chhabra retired from the ASI in 1966.
